FLOOR.title: Work with no floor: San Pedro Sula and Denver
FLOOR.question: Three in four Honduran workers are informal. What does that take away, and what happens when the price of plastic halves?
FLOOR.guessIntro: For each item, guess whether the work comes with it. Then check, and compare with two Denver workers: one with a payslip and one paid in cash.

rates.text: of Honduran workers are informal (Nov 2024); 95.7% of workers aged 15–18.
of workers pay into social security (IHSS), by the business council's own figures (our arithmetic).
a month is the average for independent workers in San Pedro Sula (2025); domestic workers and apprentices earn under L10,000.
rates.src: INE EPHPM via La Prensa, Apr 2026

rows.q: A minimum wage that applies to you

here.text: No minimum wage anyone enforces. Even among wage earners, 44.75% were paid less than the minimum in 2025.

w2.text: $19.29 an hour in 2026, for anyone working in Denver, whatever their immigration status.

cash.text: The same law covers cash work, but 62% of 411 surveyed Denver-area day laborers had been cheated of wages.
cash.src: Galemba, University of Denver, 2016–17 (via Denver Labor)

here.text: A day you don't work is a day you aren't paid.

w2.text: 1 hour for every 30 worked, up to 48 hours a year, at every employer. It also covers a sick child and weather closures.
w2.src: CDLE, Healthy Families and Workplaces Act

cash.v: Only if the boss follows the law
cash.text: Denver Labor's 2025 cases included sick-pay violations.

rows.q: Paid time off after a new baby or a serious illness or injury

here.text: Paid leave runs through the IHSS, and only for people who pay in.

w2.text: FAMLI: up to 12 weeks at about 90% of pay for lower earners, once you have $2,500 in reported Colorado wages.

cash.text: FAMLI runs on reported wages. Cash pay doesn't count.

rows.q: Pay while you look for work if the job ends

w2.text: Unemployment insurance, based on reported wages.
w2.src: our reading of the eligibility rules (Denver mirror)

cash.src: our reading of the eligibility rules (Denver mirror)

rows.q: Credit toward a pension in old age

here.text: No contributions to the IHSS, no pension from work.

w2.text: Every reported paycheck builds Social Security credits.
w2.src: our reading of the eligibility rules (Denver mirror)

cash.src: our reading of the eligibility rules (Denver mirror)

rows.q: Health care that comes with the work

here.text: Coverage through the IHSS needs contributions.

w2.text: Many low-wage jobs offer none. Health First Colorado covers adults up to 133% of the poverty level whatever their job.

cash.text: The same income-based coverage is open to them.

rows.q: A pay record a bank or landlord will accept

here.text: No payslip, so no bank loan or formal lease on that income.

w2.text: A payslip and a tax record.
w2.src: our reading of the eligibility rules (Denver mirror)

cash.src: our reading of the eligibility rules (Denver mirror)

rows.q: An office that will come if you are cheated

here.text: No contract means nothing an inspector can enforce.

w2.text: Denver Labor recovered a record $2.31 million for about 7,200 workers in 2025.

cash.text: The office covers anyone working in Denver, but fewer than 40% of cheated day laborers asked for help.
cash.src: Galemba, University of Denver, 2016–17 (via Denver Labor)

grid.after: Informal doesn't mean illegal or lazy. It means work that the protections were never built to reach: social insurance, paid sick days, paid leave. Denver has informal work too. The difference is how much of all the work it is.

HOURS.title: What the pay has to cover: San Pedro Sula and Denver
HOURS.question: What share of a month's pay does the basic basket take for a household in San Pedro Sula? Compare it with Denver.
HOURS.notice: Even the formal maquila minimum covers only about 60% of the basic basket for four. Informal pay covers less. Families pool a maquila wage, informal work and money sent from abroad.
HOURS.yourCall: How many earners does the household need? Where would the money from abroad fit in?
